thread:
Alex: Quick follow-up to the SLO-pretech RFC — can we align on the 'surface' the runtime exposes for SLO-driven prefetching? We need a minimal contract so Dedicated/Private can opt-in without pulling allocator into policy logic.

Maria: Short version: we need a hook that takes per-request latency budget + priority and returns a prefetch decision (yes/no + size estimate). Runtime then enforces budget. Avoid leaking tenant policy into allocator.

Zheng: Agree. Two options: (A) admission gateway returns `prefetch_decision{budget_ms, hint_bytes, allow_sync}`; allocator only implements `allocate_prefetch(id, bytes, timeout_ms)`. (B) Move heuristic into allocator and expose telemetry-only gateway. A is cleaner for separation.

Sam: A vs B tradeoffs: A keeps allocator simple but requires gateway to see KV cache/KV-hit history (for good hints). B allows allocator to use resident-set signals. Which signals are allowed across deployments?

Katie: For Private we can't send telemetry back. So A must work offline with local models. Gateway can be co-located in control plane for Hosted/Dedicated; Private uses a local policy agent that implements same API.

Alex: Implementation proposal (proto):
```
rpc PrefetchHint(Request) returns (PrefetchDecision) {
  Request { string req_id; int64 tenant_id; int32 budget_ms; float priority; int64 last_kv_size; }
  PrefetchDecision { bool prefetch; int64 hint_bytes; bool allow_sync; string reason; }
}
```
Allocator API: `allocate_prefetch(req_id, hint_bytes, timeout_ms)` -> token/err.

Maria: Telemetry we need: prefetch.latency_ms, prefetch.hit_rate, prefetch.bytes, prefetch.evicted_before_use. Also per-tenant fairness counters.

Zheng: Also expose `prefetch_slo_violation` counter tagged by model, route, tenant. We should keep default budget sane: 50ms for small-chat, 150ms for long-completions.

Sam: Edge: streaming responses often can't wait for sync prefetch. `allow_sync=false` fallback to async prefetch + degrade. Need a clear fallback path in runtime: if allocate_prefetch times out -> proceed with recompute path.

Katie: For rollout: canary = 5% of traffic on Dedicated with prefetch enabled, measure latencies with `prefetch.*` metrics. Run with `--prefetch-mode=hint-only` vs `--prefetch-mode=allocator`.

Alex: Quick CLI to iterate: `./dev/run_loadtest --slo-ms=50 --prefetch-mode=hint-only --canary=0.05` (we should add to perf harness). Anyone want to take a short RFC to define proto + metrics naming?

Maria: I'll draft the proto and metrics doc. I'll add simple synthetic test in perf harness. Assign to me.

Zheng: I'll prototype allocator side token path and timeouts.

Sam: I'll own rollout script and observability dashboard.

Katie: I'll double-check Private deployment constraints (KMS/network) for the local policy agent.

prefetch-bot: note: created perf-ticket INF-2021 for metrics collection :ticket:

Alex: Thanks — next sync Thursday 11am. Quick + focused. :thumbsup:
